name: Cafe Rouge
source:
Isis, your average American teenager, happens upon a part time job opening at Cafe Rouge. During the day, it is a normal, quaint cafe and bakery. But when night takes over, it is transformed into a five star restaurant-theater-cafe, with live stage performances and first class customers arriving in the middle of the night.

As Isis delves deeper into this strange cafe, she becomes entangled in the mystery of its' haunted world. Will she find friends, or enemies? Will she follow fate or make her own destiny? Will she find love?

[From [url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/29222564801/cafe-rouge-isis-your-average-american-teenager]English Otome Games[/url]]
translation:
伊西斯，一个普通的美国少女，偶然发现了红咖啡馆的兼职工作。白天，它是一家正常、别致的咖啡馆和面包店。但当夜幕降临时，它摇身一变成为五星餐厅-剧场-咖啡馆，有现场舞台表演和顶级顾客在深夜到来。

随着伊西斯深入了解这家奇怪的咖啡馆，她陷入了它闹鬼世界的谜团中。她会找到朋友，还是敌人？她会追随命运还是创造自己的命运？她会找到爱情吗？

[来自[url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/29222564801/cafe-rouge-isis-your-average-american-teenager]English Otome Games[/url]]
